ops.text: 14.11 Insurance. Commerce One shall maintain, at its own expense, throughout the term of this Agreement: (a) commercial general liability insurance of not less than USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 in the aggregate; (b) professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than USD 2,000,000; (c) where Commerce One processes Corio data, cyber and privacy liability insurance of not less than USD 5,000,000; and (d) workers' compensation insurance as required by applicable law. Commerce One shall provide Corio with certificates of insurance upon request.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We inserted a short insurance covenant because Commerce One hosts software and personnel that touch Corio data, and our playbook requires CGL of USD 1M per occurrence / 2M aggregate, E&O of USD 2M, cyber and privacy cover of USD 5M where our data is processed, workers' compensation and certificates on request. We removed the one-year post-termination coverage tail, and can accept E&O of USD 1M and cyber of USD 2M as a fallback.
proposal.summary: Insert vendor insurance covenant in Section 14 (Miscellaneous)
